test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Able to be happy, successful, etc. again after something difficult or bad has happened
solution: The correct answer is "**Resilient**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Remnant**: a part or quantity that is left after the greater part has been used, removed, or destroyed. • **Reluctant**: unwilling and hesitant; disinclined. • **Resilient**: (of a person or animal) able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions. • **Resistant**: offering resistance to something or someone. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**resilient**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. • **Example**: *The Indian cricket team was **resilient **__in winning the world cup against all odds. * Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Remnant**:वह भाग या मात्रा जो बड़े भाग के उपयोग, हटाए जाने या नष्ट होने के बाद बची हो। • **Reluctant**:अनिच्छुक और संकोच; विमुख। • **Resilient**:(किसी व्यक्ति या जानवर का) कठिन परिस्थितियों का सामना करने या जल्दी से ठीक होने में सक्षम। • **Resistant**: किसी चीज या किसी का प्रतिरोध करना। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**resilient**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. 158:T4a1, The erroneous segment is "**sell all the goods**"
